routeOrSurface: Command palette → scoped original Create Task dialog
customerOutcome: Review an editable task title and description, explicitly create through the original Native Issue owner, and reconcile an uncertain response with reads only.
entryConditions: Current resolved principal and selected company match the original command scope.
A current original command response offers create_task. Text and previews cause no writes.
Unresolved current-session checks conceal the private draft.
exitConditions: Cancel leaves no task until explicit submission.
Only a current authorized original Native create-key/Issue read allows confirmed-task presentation.

content.supportingCopy: Review your task before creating it.
displayedState: Editable task title and optional description
Pending create or unconfirmed receipt; no repeated POST
Current authorized Native task receipt or unavailable state

inputs.label: Task title
inputs.default: Verbatim text after explicit English/Danish create-task command
inputs.help: Review the title before creating the task.
inputs.validation: Trimmed non-empty value; input limited to 180 characters
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: Original same-account command text; no inferred agents, dates or access

inputs.label: What should happen?
inputs.help: Review configured automation before creation. Assignment is a separate decision.

primary.label: Create task
primary.operation: One explicit original Native Issue POST with backlog/medium/null assignees, explicit allowDuplicate=true, and frozen random UUID; no automatic or user-triggered replay POST

secondary: Check task receipt performs only original Native GET
Check Work when the outcome cannot be confirmed
Open task after current original-authorized receipt

canonicalReadDomains: Original Native create idempotency key and Issue read authorization
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Original POST /api/companies/:companyId/issues; no new writer, execution path or schema/store
systemWork.authorityEffect: Commands and keys grant no authority. The original owner authorizes creation. Backlog and null assignees describe requested fields; downstream configured automation remains Native-owned.
systemWork.asyncWork: Persist only a strict per-tab company/principal/UUID locator before one explicit POST. Storage failure blocks the write. Restore can only GET the original Native receipt; missing/erased/unavailable outcomes never cause another create.
systemWork.receipt: Minimal current ID/company/title after original Issue read and exact original board-creator checks. Keys grant no authority. A denied or unavailable receipt remains unconfirmed.

states.loading: Conceal prior private fields and receipts during current session or original-source checks.
states.empty: Explain an actual empty authorized result. Missing dependencies or qualified capabilities are separate unavailable states.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Remove executable actions and refresh canonical state; preserved input is not evidence of current authority.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain the unconfirmed outcome and offer receipt refresh or Work; do not offer another create for the frozen attempt.
states.permission_denied: Hide the private draft/receipt during an account or flag boundary and after a denied original read.
states.recovering: Refresh the original Native receipt with GET only. Never infer no effect from a failed or missing receipt.
states.success: Show only the current authorized original task; open it to review current status and choose the next step.

navigation.back: Preserve unsent inputs across a same-account flag/session recheck; a submitted attempt permits receipt reads only.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Cancel before submission closes an unsent form. After submission, closing the form leaves a minimal per-tab locator for the already-possible Native effect. Only a current authorized receipt clears that locator; no write body or raw task text is persisted.
navigation.resume: Within the same tab, recover the original per-account/company UUID after reload and read its original Native creator-bound receipt only. Closing the tab or clearing session data removes this locator. Cross-device/browser recovery remains unimplemented.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Only the current account/company-scoped draft and current original Native task title/reference
dataCollected: Explicit title/description, backlog/medium/null-assignee defaults, allowDuplicate=true and original UUID
Per-tab opaque company/principal/idempotency UUID recovery locator; maximum 16 entries/8KiB, no task text or write body, erased on settled account switch/logout or tab end.
sensitiveFields: Raw intent, company facts, feedback and results remain customer data
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Purpose-marked Native Task draft HTTP requests and the create-receipt read omit query, body, private errors and resource IDs. Ordinary Issue diagnostics retain their policy. No new telemetry or audit prose is introduced.

functional: Verify one original Native creation, read-only reconciliation after lost acknowledgement, fresh authorized receipt, and no extra created task/agent/run in the qualification fixture.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current membership/resource revocation, tenant isolation, untrusted content and separate private feedback identity purpose.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
